|game_text=Deploy on table. Your [Separatist] droids are power +1 and may shuttle from battleground systems for free. During battle, may place this Effect out of play to cancel and redraw your just-drawn destiny. Once per turn, each player may ignore any deploy cost on [Virtual Block 4] [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough{{!}}Watch Your Step]] and once per game, while that Objective on table, you may take a starfighter into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle (or draw two cards from Reserve Deck). Jedi Tests may not modify your battle or weapon destiny draws. Lost if your [Virtual Block 4] objective on table. (Immune to [[Alter]].)

* '''PC-E3''' ([[Begin Landing Your Troops & Dark Forces]]): retitled in errata posted on the Players Committee forum on 2 May 2014, effective immediately<ref name="forum-p879652">Players Committee forum, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574, now titled “Current Rulings Archive August 2012 - December 2015”), post by Lukes Bionic Hand, 2 May 2014: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=40#p879652 p879652] (read 9–11 November 2026)</ref>: the second title changed from The Dark Path to Dark Forces; the card under the slip is still Begin Landing Your Troops. '''What changed:''' the title “•Begin Landing Your Troops & The Dark Path” became “•Begin Landing Your Troops & •Dark Forces”, so that both halves are unique (The Dark Path is not); the game text did not change.
